description: This file defines the AppRegistryClient class for AWS SDK, providing methods to interact with the AWS Service Catalog App Registry service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as creating, deleting, listing, and updating resource groups and applications.

classes.name: AppRegistryClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with AWS Service Catalog App Registry, extending the generic AwsClient with specific API methods.

methods.name: associateAttributeGroup
methods.description: Associates an attribute group with a resource.

methods.name: associateAttributeGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates an attribute group with a resource.

methods.name: associateResource
methods.description: Associates a resource with an application.

methods.name: associateResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a resource with an application.

methods.name: createAttributeGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new attribute group.

methods.name: disassociateResource
methods.description: Disassociates a resource from an application.

methods.name: disassociateResourceAsync

methods.name: getApplicationAsync
